channel.title: Macao passport: visa rule changes
channel.description: Destinations whose entry rule changed for Macao passport holders, found by the daily comparison of public visa-policy sources (mainly Wikipedia). Check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Angola: Visa required → Visa-free
